// AUTO-GENERATED by puerto. Edit puerto.toml, then run `puerto generate bootstrap`; add a
// consumer with `puerto generate consumer <name> --on <event_type>`.
use infrastructure::db::events::{PgDeliveries, PgOutbox};
use puerto_events::{Loops, WorkerConfig};

/// The relay and one consumer per `[[consumer]]`, on the `db` transport: the relay hands each
/// event to `event_deliveries`, one row per consumer subscribed to its type.
pub async fn build_worker(config: WorkerConfig) -> Result<Loops, String> {
    let database_url = std::env::var("DATABASE_URL").map_err(|_| {
        "DATABASE_URL is not set — set it in .env (.env.example has one)".to_string()
    })?;
    let pool = infrastructure::db::create_postgres_pool(&database_url)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| format!("{e} — is the database up? `make docker-compose/up`"))?;
    infrastructure::db::run_migrations(&pool, &infrastructure::db::MIGRATOR)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    Ok(Loops::new(&config).relay(PgOutbox::new(pool.clone()), PgDeliveries::new(pool)))
}
